text:
devon_sales: FYI AuroraHealth procurement needs a compliance bundle to sign the PO. Request: redacted SOC2 control matrix excerpt, a signed pentest attestation for our isolated staging env addressed to their CISO, and a ballpark delta for an on-prem VM vs hosted POC. Can we deliver by Thursday? @lee_se @nina_compliance @marc_sec

lee_se: I can estimate the on-prem delta. Ballpark: one-time packaging/validation $11k, monthly support $1.7k. If they want us to coordinate a pentest window add $1k. Will confirm by EOD.

nina_compliance: We can produce the SOC2 control matrix excerpt + scope page, redacting hostnames and internal IDs. Need ~24 hours to prepare signed redacted PDFs.

marc_sec: Pen-test attestation: we can provide a signed letter confirming a third-party test of the isolated staging cluster. We won't include vulnerability details. If Aurora wants their vendor to test, require NDA addendum, POA from Legal, a scoped CIDR and a 2-4 hour agreed window. That adds ~2 business days.

devon_sales: Aurora prefers CIDR in the attestation. Is that OK?

marc_sec: Prefer descriptive scope with CIDR available on request. If we include CIDR in the letter, Legal will review.

proof-bot: Ticket EVID-5256 created: Aurora proofpack. Checklist: SOC2 excerpt, pentest attestation, NDA addendum, network isolation sketch. Owner: devon_sales.

devon_sales: Lee  can you paste a tiny ASCII network sketch?

lee_se: Sure:

```
[Internet] -> Ingress LB -> Bastion (jumpbox) -> Isolated Staging VPC
No peering with production; monitoring via read-only telemetry to S3.
```

marc_sec: Draft attestation snippet:

"We confirm that Redwood Inference engaged an accredited third-party to perform a penetration test scoped to the isolated staging environment for the AuroraHealth POC. The scope was limited to the staging cluster and related ingress points. Detailed findings are withheld; a high-level summary may be provided under NDA."

nina_compliance: I'll post redacted SOC2 PDFs by tomorrow noon. Marc  please route the attestation to Legal once you have the signed draft.

devon_sales: Thanks team  I'll tell Aurora procurement the nonbinding estimate and update after artifacts are posted. :thumbsup:
